children: Timothy Schmid, an officer serving as EVP, WW Chair, MedTech, executed two direct sales on September 2, 2026. The sales were for common stock at $274.74 per share. The total reported sale amount was $9,230,439. Following the transactions, Schmid directly owned 25,447 shares and indirectly owned 804 shares (including amounts held in the 401(k) and ESOP as of the plans' most recent reporting date).
